title: Support The Show
html:
Listen to the 2024 Burning Man Reasearch episodes in partnership with The Camp of the Unknown God!

Burning Curiosity W/Carl Teichrib Part 1 (Apple Podcasts)

In this episode, Basil has a conversation with Carl Teichrib to get insight into this years Burning Man. In addition, the youngest member of the Camp of the Unknown God, Kaden the Canadian, discusses his experience of how he found himself in Black Rock City. Finally, we hear from the actual Burning of the Man, where Basil gets really uncomfortable.

Burning Curiosity W/ Carl Teichrib Part 2 (Apple Podcasts)

What happens when you put Christians from Canada, UK, and America in a tent at Burning Man? A fantastic conversation! In addition, a sit down interview with George! On this episode of Canary Cry Radio, part 2 of Burning Curiosity 2024! Go listen to PART 1!

Basil, Carl, Austin, Mark, Brian, Audrey, Caleb, George

Produce (Support) Burning Man Research
